record_type_quote: We conducted a preregistered direct replication (N=202) and conceptual replications in the United States (N=352) and the Netherlands (N=81).

targets.title: Political Attitudes Vary with Physiological Traits.
targets.evidence_quote: Our replications focus on the most prominent test of the Oxley et al. study that physiological responses to threatening images correlate with ideology.
targets.outcome_quote: We, reluctantly, reject the foundational assumption of Oxley et al.’s work.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly report no support for the finding retested.
